Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Account Management team at Bridge is dedicated to the growth, retention, and expansion of key customers. Our Enterprise Account Management team focuses on driving measurable expansion across a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers through deep account knowledge, flawless technical execution and strong cross-functional partnership.
Why Bridge
Join a team that values clear thinking, quantitative rigor, and customer obsession. At Bridge you’ll own meaningful customer outcomes, operate with autonomy, and have the opportunity to shape how we scale revenue across high-potential accounts.

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Bridge you will own a book of existing Enterprise and Strategic accounts and be responsible for deepening relationships, expanding revenue, identifying product gaps and driving product adoption, preventing churn and securing long-term renewals.

Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

As Bridge continues to develop within Stripe’s Money Management organization, you will also drive your customers’ adoption of additional features available through Stripe.

Develop account plans and cross sell into your list of strategic customers, driving growth through expansion and new revenue streams
Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business, deeply understanding problems they are solving and helping drive to solutions
Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship
Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Bridge/Stripe sales culture
Think strategically about opportunities to scale account relationships beyond Bridge product adoption into wider Stripe use-cases
Lead commercial negotiations and renewals to expand and retain customer revenue.
Identify churn signals in your book and implement strategies to prevent revenue losses.
Coordinate with product, success, risk, and operations teams to solve complex customer needs and ensure a great user experience.
Translate customer feedback into actionable product and process improvements to better serve scaled customer segments.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

8+ years of full sales cycle or account management experience focused on existing business accounts; preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
6+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required
Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to close upsell opportunities and manage complex pricing or commercial negotiations.
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
Willingness and ability to work in-office in London at least three days per week.

Previous experience at a high-growth payments, fintech, crypto, or technology company.
Experience with CRM tools, Excel, and basic SQL or a demonstrated comfort with data tools and analysis.
Background in working cross-functionally with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver outcomes for customers.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in the growth of its Issuing and Treasury businesses, which help platforms and businesses embed financial products.

As a Sales Manager of Issuing and Treasury Product Sales, you will lead a high-performing team of product sales executives and be a critical member of the leadership team responsible for growing adoption of Issuing and Treasury across the Americas.

Few roles offer such a direct opportunity to shape the commercial success of a strategic product area while developing the next generation of product sales leaders.

As the Manager, AMER Issuing and Treasury Product Sales, you will recruit, develop, and lead a team of product sales executives responsible for delivering ambitious growth goals across Issuing and Treasury.
You will bring strong sales leadership, operating rigor, and a customer-first mindset to a complex and evolving product area. You will help your team navigate consultative, technical, and cross-functional sales cycles, partnering closely with Core Sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, Risk, Compliance, Partnerships, Finance, Marketing, and Sales Development.
The ideal candidate has demonstrated success managing and developing enterprise sales teams, bringing complex products to market, operating effectively through ambiguity, and building durable sales motions in a high-growth environment.

Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Issuing and Treasury product sales executives across AMER.
Set a clear strategy and operating plan that delivers against pipeline, bookings, attach rate, adoption, and revenue goals.
Manage day-to-day business operations, including pipeline creation, deal progression, forecasting, performance against targets, and inspection of key sales metrics.
Coach the team to lead consultative, solution-based sales cycles with prospective and existing users, from discovery through close and launch.
Partner closely with Core AEs to identify, prioritize, and execute on the highest-potential Issuing and Treasury opportunities.
Engage directly in the largest and most strategic opportunities, building executive relationships, shaping commercial strategy, and helping the team win.
Develop and refine scalable sales motions for new business, expansion, and strategic account growth across Issuing and Treasury.
Build strong feedback loops with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to surface market needs, unblock critical deals, and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
Translate product capabilities, implementation requirements, and regulatory considerations into clear value propositions for users.
Create structure and focus for GTM initiatives, product launches, campaigns, and enablement programs. Drive execution, measure outcomes, and make timely recommendations for improvement.
Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development, creating clear expectations and meaningful career growth opportunities for direct reports.
Lead with clarity and context, communicating a compelling plan that is aligned with Stripe’s strategy and the broader Global Issuing and Treasury Sales organization.
Continuously improve sales processes, operating mechanisms, and team effectiveness by sharing best practices and testing new approaches.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

10+ years of technology sales experience
5+ years of people leadership experience
3+ years of experience in payments or financial services industry
Demonstrated success leading enterprise new-business and expansion sales motions.
Experience selling complex, technical, or regulated products through multi-stakeholder buying processes.
Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performance sales team, and work in a matrixed environment
Ability to build cross-functional relationships, motivate others, drive collaboration, teaming & resolve conflict between diverse stakeholder groups
High energy, strong work ethic, disciplined execution skills, willingness to do whatever it takes to deliver results
True team player - always
Humor is very welcomed

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
As a Sr. Client Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving business results for Pinterest’s largest strategic advertisers. Your expertise throughout the funnel tactics will help you grow and nurture client relationships and guide them from awareness through to conversion and retention.

We’re looking for a Client Account Manager to help our most strategic partners successfully grow their business through Pinterest. You’ll work directly with some of our key advertisers as a trusted consultant to their business. Your strategic advice, analytical skills and sales skills are core to bringing to life the value we deliver as a platform.
In this role, you'll bring that expertise to one of Pinterest's most dynamic and high-growth verticals, Beauty.

Beauty brands on Pinterest operate across the full funnel, from driving mass awareness of new product launches and seasonal collections, to inspiring consideration through tutorials and shade-matching content, to closing the loop with shoppable Pins and conversion-optimized campaigns.

You'll be the strategic backbone for some of the most recognizable beauty and personal care brands in the world, helping them connect with Pinterest's uniquely purchase-minded audience at every stage of the journey.
We invite passionate candidates to join our US Enterprise Sales team, where we have open positions across several business sectors, in various locations. By applying for the Sr. Client Account Manager position, your application will be considered for all available roles that match your skills and experience. Submit your resume once, and it will be considered by multiple hiring teams.

Plan, execute, upsell, and optimize data-driven ad campaigns in collaboration with internal teams.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships, aligning with stakeholder goals across all funnel stages.
Ensure accurate implementation of first-party data and campaign launches with cross-functional teams.
Optimize media campaigns and audience targeting daily using various technologies and platforms.
Deliver weekly campaign performance reporting and insights.
Advise clients on Pinterest ad products, targeting, bidding, creative, and measurement strategies.
Provide exceptional client service through communication, issue resolution, and seamless execution.
Simplify complex processes, upsell and pitch strategic solutions, and continuously improve campaigns.

Proven experience managing and growing client accounts with data-driven strategies.
Strong knowledge of advertising best practices and technical media measurement.
Skilled at identifying client needs, communicating persuasive recommendations, and overcoming objections.
Ability to build and execute full-funnel sales strategies, driving adoption and conversions.
Excellent at managing multiple campaigns, tasks, and timelines simultaneously.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to explore AI tools to improve day-to-day productivity, including campaign setup, performance reporting, client communications, and research. Leverages AI to work more efficiently, whether it's streamlining optimizations, preparing for client meetings, or surfacing insights from campaign data, while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or related field, or equivalent experience.

We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our New York office.
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

Function as Territory Sales Manager for our Material Handling, Port and OTR product lines. Act as the account manager for dealers, target accounts and strategic customers in your assigned territory.
Identify opportunities through customer needs-analysis and knowledge of competitor products
Act as business advisor with your target accounts to sell the value proposition bringing value to their organization
Sell new End Users ultimately increasing the revenue and profitability of the Specialty Industrial Business Area (BA)
Establish business within the Industrial BA’s profitability targets
Collectively manage an effective pricing strategy and individually implement this strategy to your target accounts
Identify opportunities for new product lines
Assist in the development of product strategy per target account to ensure current product lines are renewed or discarded in a normal product life cycle plan so that competition is not able to circumvent the market share of Continental Tire North America at the account
Conduct market intelligence to identify target accounts and establish geographic target areas
Manage the implementation of the strategic marketing, sales and operational initiatives to support your identified target accounts
Make Sales Calls, conduct face to face meetings with call plans
Assist in monthly Forecasting Evolution with Regional Manager
Achieve assigned sales targets in assigned region
Participate in sales meetings, product and training meetings and trade events

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax's unwavering mission.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

New York

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We are hiring a Client Sales Senior Account Manager to our Client Sales team in Santa Catarina.
As an Client Sales Senior Account Manager , you will be at the forefront of Wellhub’s growth strategy, driving revenue by connecting with HR leadership and executive decision-makers across enterprise organizations . You will own the full sales cycle from discovery to close, designing tailored corporate wellbeing solutions that deliver real business impact.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love consultative selling, and are passionate about promoting corporate wellness, this is your place to make an impact.

Territory Leadership & Ownership: Take full ownership of your territory, autonomously designing and executing strategic sales plans to proactively lead business generation across your region.
Master Consultative Selling: Engage directly with HR professionals, Corporate Health leaders, and key decision-makers, up to the C-suite, to uncover organizational pain points, articulate Wellhub’s value proposition, and align our solutions with their strategic business goals.
Strong Stakeholder Management: Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional teams, partnering closely with Sales Development for lead generation, Channel Partners to drive pipeline and close deals, and the Onboarding team to ensure the successful launch of newly signed clients.
Drive Strategy & Enterprise Growth: Execute creative outreach tactics to identify and empower internal client champions, navigating complex corporate buying processes to drive key revenue milestones and expand Wellhub’s enterprise footprint across your territory.
Craft Value-Driven Proposals: Build customized business proposals that match the specific needs, operational structures, and strategic goals of each prospect.
Sales Excellence & CRM Management: Diligently execute internal sales processes, including opportunity generation, end-to-end pipeline management, and accurate forecasting within our CRM.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

B2B Sales Expertise: Demonstrated track record of high performance in complex B2B consultative selling within enterprise accounts. Prior experience engaging directly with HR, People Operations, Corporate Health & Wellness, and executive decision-makers is strongly preferred.
Seniority & Professional Maturity: Exhibit a high level of maturity and accountability. You are a self-starter who thrives with autonomy and adopts a proactive, constructive approach to driving business growth and value creation.
Sales Operations Discipline: Highly organized with strong pipeline management skills and a habit of keeping internal processes and CRM data up to date. Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
Excellent Communicator: Outgoing, enthusiastic, and persuasive conversationalist with outstanding active listening and negotiation skills. The ability to speak publicly, participate in industry panels, and represent Wellhub at external events is desired.
Scale-Up Mindset: Experienced in, or highly adaptable to, fast-paced, high-growth business environments. You can navigate evolving operational structures smoothly while maintaining a positive attitude and strong team spirit.
Fluent in Portuguese and English.
This is a hybrid position, candidate must be located in Santa Catarina. With travel availability, wilingness to travel monthly to visit prospects, clients, and represent Wellhub at industry events, as well as availability for quarterly visits to the São Paulo office.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.For this role, prior experience in B2B sales and advanced level of English are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.
Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay] . With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.
In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with C-level executives and account managers of our top brands and distributors in the category. You will be one of the key external representatives of Jumia in this category, alongside the Country Managing Director and CCO.
Develop and execute strategic plans to drive sales growth and maximize revenue across your portfolio.
Lead the acquisition of new high-potential brands and large distributors to enrich our assortment and consolidate Jumia’s leadership in your category.
Identify and unlock monetization opportunities by promoting and selling Jumia’s advertising and visibility services to brands and partners in your portfolio.
Collaborate with marketing and commercial planning teams to build promotional campaigns tailored to your accounts and the category dynamics.
Analyze sales performance and market data to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
Monitor and report on key account metrics, including sales, inventory, campaign performance, and customer satisfaction.
Negotiate win-win agreements and long-term partnerships with key accounts, ensuring mutual profitability and sustainable collaboration.
Stay ahead of market trends, competitor activity, and evolving customer preferences to inform your strategy and recommendations.
Coordinate closely with internal teams (merchandising, operations, logistics, etc.) to ensure flawless execution and customer satisfaction.

Minimum 3 years of experience in the category or retail industry in the market, with a strong understanding of local market dynamics and players.
In-depth knowledge of your market category ecosystem, including key brands, distributors, and consumer trends.
Graduate of a top-tier business or engineering school (Top 5 in your country or internationally recognized equivalent).
Proven commercial acumen with a strong track record of delivering business results and driving negotiations with senior stakeholders.
Solid analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, derive insights, and define actionable strategies.
Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient in MS Office, Google Workspace, and familiar with CRM or relationship management tools.
Comfortable working with digital tools and dashboards to monitor performance and inform decision-making.
Exceptional interpersonal and influencing skills: able to build trust, rally teams, and drive alignment internally and externally.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven and highly competitive environment.

We are looking to accelerate our growth by adding teammates who have the right qualifications and drive to meet the needs of our current customers and drive the next stage of our expansion!
As a Key Account Manager at Marqeta, you will manage strategic accounts, focusing on relationship-building, revenue growth, and addressing customer needs through insightful solutions and data-driven strategies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide exceptional client service, uncover revenue-generating opportunities, and deliver workable solutions to your customers.
This position requires a proactive, resourceful team player who has the ability to take ownership of projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and to see those initiatives to completion while streamlining processes and allowing our team to scale the growth of our business. No day is the same in this role, as this role is key to working across our partners, customers, and organization to drive innovation in the industry.
We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely anywhere within the United States or from our Oakland office. We’d love for you to join us!

This role performs a wide range of activities, including maintaining and growing revenue by identifying new upsell and cross-sell opportunities, in addition to:
Collaborate with AE partners to drive all aspects of a customer growth and retention strategy, including:
Day-to-day management of customer portfolio.
Ensure partnership and programs are running smoothly and successfully.
Be a trusted leader to the customer and help them navigate the payments landscape.

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We are looking for a high-performing Senior Sales Manager to join our Marketing Solutions department, owning and growing a portfolio of enterprise life science accounts. You will drive full-cycle sales—from strategic outbound prospecting to close— selling high-value digital advertising solutions and custom media campaigns directly to life science marketers and their media agencies.
This is a consultative, multi-stakeholder digital media sale with true deal ownership and a clear sense of purpose. You won't just pitch and pass; you will architect partnerships that connect pioneering life science brands with the global scientific community.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, you will join a high-performing, international, and collaborative commercial team focused on connecting researchers with tools and solutions that accelerate scientific progress.

Drive Ad Revenue: Close net-new and expansion digital advertising business across a dedicated portfolio of pharma, biotech, and scientific brands.
Consultative Media Selling: Run structured, deeply analytical discovery sessions to understand brand objectives and build tailored, insight-led digital media and content strategy proposals .
Navigate Marketer Ecosystems: Confidently pitch to and steer deals through complex brand teams, digital marketing leads, agency partners , and procurement.
Strategic Account Planning: Build and execute long-term account roadmaps to scale our share of wallet and maximize ad spend within key organizations.
Collaborate for Campaign Success: Partner closely with Account Management and Ad Ops to ensure ad campaigns perform flawlessly against client KPIs , securing renewals and long-term retention.

Consistently hitting and exceeding your quarterly advertising revenue quota.
Growing key enterprise accounts year-over-year through strategic digital media upselling.
Delivering high-ROI ad campaigns that naturally convert into predictable, repeat business.

The Track Record : 5+ years of closing experience in B2B digital advertising, ad-tech, digital media sales, or publisher solutions.
Marketer Fluency : Deep understanding of digital advertising metrics (CPM, CTR, lead generation, brand awareness) and how life science marketers allocate budgets.

Unmatched Digital Reach: Tap into a unique, highly coveted global audience of 26M+ verified researchers that marketers cannot find anywhere else.

An International, High-Performing Culture: Work alongside a diverse, driven team scaling a world-class platform.

Berlin Hub: Our team comes together in our vibrant Berlin office 3 days a week .

Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde.

L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie et à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation.

L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs. Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché.

L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d' Ajax Systems . L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur.

Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d' Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication.

Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS. L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre.

La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax. Founder-led sales have closed enterprise deals. We've brought in experienced GTM help to build early infrastructure and playbooks. We're looking for a Technical Account Executive to join our small and growing Buyer Experience Squad.

You've built before . You know what it's like to operate without a finished playbook and have built out a new role, team, or function from zero

You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

s.h: This role is NOT for you if
s.t:
You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.
30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance . Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.
How to join the mission? 🚀
First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo , to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.
Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.

📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options.
🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally.

Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light.

You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
Why We Have This Role
Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the DACH market. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences.

Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time.

In the Enterprise Sales role, you will be working with Major Accounts with an overarching objective to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base.

This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients.
How You’ll Find Success
Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.
Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.
Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.
Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.
Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team.
How You’ll Grow
By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.
You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI.
Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.
As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue.
We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics.
Things You’ll Do
Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.
Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.
Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.
Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts.
Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions.
Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.
Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts.
Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement & connections at the highest level.
Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals.
Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts.
Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account.
Fluency in German and English.
You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them.
You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions.
You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy.
You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.
You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business.
You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals.
What You Should Know About This Team
Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.
As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.
The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.
Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.
We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

s.h: Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
s.t:
Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing
Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other
At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader.

These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Small businesses are the backbone of any community- and you’ll be the partner that helps them thrive with Square. From the local salon to the personal trainer down the street, we’re looking for someone with a genuine passion for SMBs in the Services space, excited by the opportunity to work alongside business owners and champion their growth.
In this role, you’ll build meaningful partnerships with clients, understanding their unique needs, crafting tailored solutions, and advocating for them within Square. You’ll become a creative problem-solver, finding ways to apply our products to complex business scenarios. As a trusted advisor, you’ll support clients day-to-day while uncovering new growth opportunities and expanding partnerships that fuel their success.
Your day-to-day blends high-energy outreach, consultative conversations, and business coaching, with a focus on helping sellers get the most from Square. You’ll have autonomy to lead your playbook and influence how Square scales in the Services industry, delivering tangible results for your merchants.

Own, retain, and grow a portfolio of SMB Services merchants, helping them thrive through tailored adoption of Square tools.
Drive expansion through product adoption, upselling, and value-based recommendations.
Act as the voice of your merchants within Square, advocating for their needs with empathy and surfacing insights that shape our products.
Balance proactive outreach, retention activities, and growth opportunities through strong organization and time management.
Work with our Sales, Support and Product teams to ensure customers have the best possible experience across all aspects of Square

Excellent organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
Passion and knowledge about how new technologies can help better serve small and medium size businesses
A track record of delivering measurable outcomes, driving adoption, and being perceived as a trusted advisor by clients.

At HEY HOLY, our mission is simple: help dogs live longer, healthier lives through better nutrition.
Instead of creating one-size-fits-all products, we develop breed-specific nutrition designed around the unique needs of every dog. Developed alongside veterinary experts, our products are helping thousands of dogs across Germany live healthier lives every day.
Since launching in 2022, we've grown into one of Germany's fastest-growing DTC pet nutrition brands, serving over 20,000 dogs through our subscription model.
As our Regional Sales Manager, your mission is simple: Build the highest-performing field sales team in Germany.
You'll be the bridge between leadership and our field sales team, ensuring every field sales agent has the coaching, tools, confidence and accountability needed to consistently perform at their best.
This is a hands-on leadership role that balances several things: recruiting and onboarding new team members, coaching on the ground, hosting trainings, coordinating the team day-to-day, and managing it on both a personnel and a performance level.

You'll spend meaningful time out in the field alongside the team, mostly in the Frankfurt region, but just as much time building the team: developing training programmes, shaping onboarding, supporting new starters, analysing performance, and working closely with leadership to continuously raise the bar.
Success in this role isn't measured by your own sales - it's measured by the success of the people you recruit, develop, and lead.
Tasks
Further build the team: Own hiring, onboarding, and training for every field sales agent - giving them the knowledge, confidence, and skills to perform from day one
Coach on the ground: Be present where it counts, through regular stand visits, live feedback, and structured development plans that turn good agents into great ones
Drive performance: Own the numbers that matter - sales, customer experience, and retention - using data and field observations to spot trends, strengths, and where to intervene
Have the fun and the hard conversations: Hold honest performance discussions, build clear improvement plans where they're needed, and recognise and reward strong performers - always keeping the bar high
Protect the standard: Ensure the sales process, stand presentation, and brand experience stay consistently excellent across every event, and keep the team sharp with refresher trainings and workshops as we grow
Build the culture: Create a team defined by ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement - and set the tone by leading from the front whenever you're in the field
Partner with leadership: Work closely with the Head of Direct Sales and the Events Coordinator to raise performance and operational standards across the board

Sales Experience: You bring first experience leading, coaching, or developing sales teams, ideally gained in retail or face-to-face customer acquisition - yet not a must.
Passion for Developing People : You genuinely enjoy helping others improve. You get satisfaction from seeing individuals grow into confident, high-performing sales professionals.
Performance Mindset : You understand that great coaching exists to drive measurable results. You know how to set expectations, monitor progress and improve performance through structured coaching.
Leadership Through Action: You earn credibility through your own behaviours, professionalism and standards.
Excellent Communication : Whether you're motivating a top performer or delivering difficult feedback, you're clear, honest and respectful.
Adaptability : No two events are the same. You stay calm, practical and solutions-focused when plans change or challenges arise.
Local Presence and Communication Skills: You speak fluent German (C1+) and confident English, and are happy to travel regularly across the Frankfurt region.

Founded in 2017, we’re delivering low-cost and large-scale energy storage and producing battery materials in the U.S. for the first time, all from batteries we already have.
Business Development Manager – Consumer Technology We are seeking a Business Development Manager – Consumer Technology, to join the team at Redwood. In this position, you will be responsible for managing relationships with consumer technology and device companies and establishing partnerships to source and recycle lithium-ion batteries.

This role is vital to our overall mission and is a key driving force to meeting our company goals in accelerating the production of local, sustainable battery materials and ensuring that end-of-life batteries and materials are collected and processed safely.

This position will include strategic account planning, account development, relationship management, and sales management across consumer technology partnerships.

You will also serve as the commercial point person for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, a consumer-facing collection initiative that places battery drop-off bins at high-traffic community locations. You’ll work with business and technical teams across Redwood, collaborating to solve business problems with multiple stakeholders.

The person who takes on this challenge, if successful, will be instrumental in paving the way for how this industry is shaped and the future of sourcing at Redwood. Responsibilities will include:
Build, foster and maintain relationships with consumer technology companies and device manufacturers to coordinate multi-level partnerships for the collection and recycling of lithium-ion battery materials. Align multiple locations and global stakeholders when necessary.
Serve as the primary point of contact for consumer technology partnership, managing end-to-end account relationships from initial engagement through long-term partnership execution. Understand each partner’s product lifecycle, sustainability commitments, and battery disposal needs to position Redwood as their preferred recycling partner.
Manage the product qualification process with customers, understanding the technical requirements for consumer device battery recycling, and communicate with key stakeholders internally and externally to manage qualification timelines and customers’ expectations.
Accountable for making sure the business is on track – ensuring a strong mix of consumer technology partnerships, that we’re exceeding customer expectations, and that battery material is procured profitably considering sourcing cost, operating costs, and logistics cost to feed the machine that is producing the most sustainable battery materials in the world.
Recognize customers’ product roadmaps and sustainability programs in detail, aligning our resources to the right programs and priorities, as well as identifying future growth opportunities in the consumer electronics battery sourcing space.
Understand customers’ value chain and the influences of each player in the ecosystem. Direct global resources to manage the value chain appropriately as well as negotiate the various contracts (volume, prices, all other T&Cs) with customers.
Own business development and operational oversight for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, including partner pipeline development, outreach, proposals, contracting, and expansion planning.
Identify, prioritize, and develop relationships with Battery Bin host partners, including retailers, municipalities, universities, nonprofits, and public agencies. Evaluate deployment opportunities and lead the end-to-end launch process from partner qualification through go-live and ongoing account management.
Develop partnership models and partner-facing materials for Battery Bin deployments, including grant-funded, leased, sponsored, or paid service structures, as well as pitch decks, implementation guides, FAQs, and related collateral.
Track and report performance across consumer device partnerships and Battery Bin sites, using data to improve partner targeting, operational efficiency, cost-to-serve, and overall program economics.
Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, logistics, legal, policy, communications, and compliance teams to ensure partnerships and collection programs are compliant, high impact, and operationally sustainable.
Ability to travel 25% when necessary for meetings, tours, site visits, and program launches.

Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, sustainability, engineering or related fields. Technical background a plus.
Sales/business/technical sales experience more than 10 years.
Consumer electronics or lithium-ion battery industry experience is strongly preferred. Direct experience working with or at companies that manufacture, assemble, sell, or repair consumer devices.
Deep understanding of consumer technology product lifecycles, sustainability initiatives, and circular economy programs within the consumer electronics industry.
Experience building and scaling partner programs, channel programs, or distributed collection and deployment networks.
Fluent in English for global communication to lead the account management.
Strong leadership skills with logical communication.
People skills to develop good relationships with customers even when in difficult to navigate situations.
Data-driven mindset with experience tracking program KPIs and using performance data to inform strategy and improve operations.
Smart, scrappy, entrepreneurial, science-loving, having a bias for action and a lot of grit.
An ability to have fun while tackling hard problems!
A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place!

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.
What you'll actually do
You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands on the market. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides.

You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.
What this role could turn into
Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.
Who thrives here
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it.

You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.
We hire for range
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $50K to 500K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure.

Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.
Location and working policy
📍 Dublin or London, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Reseller Channel Partnerships team is responsible for defining, establishing, and scaling Square's growth via channel distribution partners. Reporting to the Head of Reseller Channel Partnerships, we are looking for an experienced business development manager to define and execute Square's partnership strategy with the Global Reseller Community.

We view Resellers as a significant, untapped distribution channel for Square, and are looking for someone with the track record and relationships in this space to define and execute our approach. This is a highly visible position, with regular exposure to company leadership.

Partner with internal teams, spanning Product Management, Marketing, Finance, Sales, Legal, and more
Be accountable for the business results of your partnerships

5+ years of experience in signing, launching, and growing distribution partnerships with ISO's, ISV's and VAR's that have resulted in measurable new customer acquisition and revenue growth
Deep understanding of the Global Reseller landscape, market dynamics, and key issues
Strong analytical skills with ability to demonstrate return on investment for partner initiatives
Excellent project management skills and ability to lead cross-functional, global initiatives
Strategic thinking with ability to identify and capitalize on new growth opportunities
Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills

Background in fintech or payments industry
MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Scale Ecosystem Sales Manager - EMEA

As a Scale Ecosystem Sales Manager - Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), you'll help fuel GitLab's growth by turning our emerging partner ecosystem into a consistent, scalable source of new customers.

Based in the UK, with Dublin also considered, you'll focus on partner-sourced Scale pipeline generation through repeatable partner-led campaigns, systematic account mapping, and whitespace analysis.

You'll work with Scale Account Executives, Field Marketing, regional sales leadership, distributors, long-tail resellers, and hyperscalers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud to integrate partners throughout the sales cycle and accelerate marketplace transactions.
You'll own programmatic partner engagement across your territory, from identifying and recruiting partners to enabling and activating them at scale. Your work will support GitLab's Scale growth targets by building a measurable, partner-led demand engine through event strategies, one-to-many campaigns, partner portals, and automated systems. You'll also contribute to business planning, pipeline forecasting, and clear reporting on partner impact.

Drive partner-sourced Scale pipeline generation through scalable partner programs, campaigns, and systematic account mapping.
Collaborate with Scale Account Executives, Field Marketing, and regional sales leaders to integrate partners into territory planning and demand generation.
Execute repeatable partner-led campaigns aligned with regional territories, including industry plays, account blitzes, and market-specific roadshows.
Identify whitespace and map accounts with partners to surface new customer opportunities and expand first-order reach.
Identify, recruit, and build programmatic relationships with emerging partners, distributors, long-tail resellers, and hyperscalers such as AWS and Google Cloud.
Support partner enablement and activation, including hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace acceleration initiatives.
Execute event-driven partner strategies, including partner alignment before events, lead capture during events, and pipeline conversion after events.
Manage one-to-many partner engagement through partner portals and automated systems, providing weekly forecasts and reports that track partner-sourced pipeline, campaign performance, and territory impact against regional Scale growth targets.

Experience in business-to-business sales development, business development, or partner-driven pipeline generation, including identifying and recruiting ecosystem partners.
Familiarity with partner ecosystems and programmatic demand generation involving distributors, long-tail resellers, and hyperscalers such as AWS and Google Cloud.
Ability to design, execute, and improve scalable demand generation approaches, including one-to-many partner engagement and event-driven campaigns.
Experience using Salesforce and sales development or marketing automation tools to manage, forecast, and report on partner-sourced pipeline and campaign performance.
Analytical skills to interpret campaign results, partner activation metrics, and territory impact, then turn those insights into clear plans.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with account executives, Field Marketing, and regional sales leadership.
Fluency in English. German, French, or Spanish language skills are a strong plus for this EMEA-wide role.
Interest in GitLab, open source software, and modern software development practices, with openness to travel and to applying transferable experience from sales, partnerships, or digital marketing in a remote, results-focused environment.

The Ecosystem Sales team builds and scales a partner network that supports Scale growth through partner-sourced pipeline and new customer acquisition. You'll join a distributed team that works closely with Scale Account Executives, Field Marketing, regional sales leadership, distributors, long-tail resellers, and hyperscalers. We collaborate asynchronously across regions to make it easier for partners to acquire and grow GitLab customers.

PagerDuty (NYSE:PD) is a leader in Digital Operations Management. In an always-on world, organizations of all sizes trust PagerDuty to help them deliver a perfect digital experience to their customers, every time.

Teams use PagerDuty to identify issues and opportunities in real time and bring together the right people to fix problems faster and prevent them in the future. Over 13,000 organizations (including 60 of Fortune 100) rely on PagerDuty to succeed with Digital Transformation, Cloud Migration, and DevOps Modernization.

Notable customers include GE, Cisco, Genentech, Electronic Arts, Cox Automotive, Netflix, Shopify, Zoom, DoorDash, Lululemon and more. We are expanding rapidly as a platform for Digital Operations Management using AI/ML and Automation and growing our adoption by Development, IT, Customer Service, Security, and other teams across the organization.
PagerDuty is seeking an Account Manager to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As an Account Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of existing SaaS customers, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

You will maintain and grow customer relationships, drive product adoption, manage renewals, and identify strategic expansion opportunities that deliver measurable business value.

This is an exciting opportunity to blend customer success and sales expertise to help customers realize the full potential of PagerDuty’s platform while driving revenue growth.
The ideal candidate is a proactive relationship builder with strong commercial acumen, a passion for data-driven customer management, and experience with SaaS products and AI-driven insights.

Own a portfolio of existing customers to ensure adoption, value realization, and retention.
Develop and execute account plans that drive renewals, mitigate churn risk, and uncover expansion opportunities.
Present and negotiate renewal proposals, structure multi-year options, and manage contract value through strategic account management.
Monitor customer health using usage analytics, telemetry, and business insights to identify and address risks early.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Sales Operations, and Renewals teams to ensure smooth contracting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Maintain strong product knowledge and deliver consultative guidance to drive configuration optimization and feature adoption.

7+ years of combined customer-facing experience, including Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals.
4+ years of proven success managing renewals and growth within a SaaS environment.
Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) and analytics tools such as Gainsight, Tableau, or Looker.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and health metrics to manage and retain customer accounts.
Familiarity with the MEDDPICC and Command of the Message (COM) frameworks.
Experience working with enterprise software customers or in a DevOps environment.
Strong understanding of AI-powered tools and how they can be leveraged to drive efficiency and insight.
Proven history of achieving revenue and retention goals through consultative account management.
Self-starter with strong collaboration, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

About Tripadvisor
The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences.

We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc.

(Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.
Viator, a Tripadvisor company, is the leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 300,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and all the niche, interesting stuff in between)—memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

With industry-leading flexibility and last-minute availability, it's never too late to make any day extraordinary. Viator. One app, 300,000+ travel experiences you’ll remember.
We are seeking a driven and high-performing Key Account Manager who will be responsible for the health and quality of the Viator product offering within their designated portfolio of high value accounts across various destinations. The Key Account Manager will have a deep understanding of trends, opportunities, and challenges within their accounts and work to optimize Viator’s product offering to best match the consumer demand in terms of product variety, pricing, and availability.
You are a brand ambassador that will focus on a select number of high valued accounts to ensure continued optimization and growth. You will be responsible for meeting/exceeding key performance indicators and maintaining/improving the overall commercial health of your accounts.

In this role you will be working with both internal and external stakeholders to align on necessary product offerings in your set of accounts, carrying out critically important tasks to maintain and grow our competitive advantage and continually improve Viator’s catalogue of experiences.
Job Location: Hybrid
This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our London Office.

Strategic Partnership & Account Growth
Lead as the primary point of contact for high-value global accounts, forging and maintaining deep, strategic relationships.
Diagnose and proactively address unique business opportunities, identifying scalable solutions to deliver results.
Develop and execute account strategies that are directly tied to business objectives and measurable growth.
Product Excellence & Optimization
Elevate and maintain a best-in-class product portfolio for the assigned accounts to maximize traveller appeal.
Ensure product quality, availability, and optimal pricing, directly aligning the offering with evolving traveller and market demand.
Leverage knowledge of the online travel industry to serve as a trusted expert and deliver actionable insights to partners.
Commercial Leadership & Performance
Negotiate favorable commercial terms that protect and maximise Viator's profitability.
Proactively monitor and analyse key performance metrics, taking swift corrective actions to maintain and improve the overall commercial health of accounts.
Provide regular, concise performance reports and strategic updates to senior management on account status, growth forecasts, and potential business risks.
Partner Success & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Champion rapid issue resolution by collaborating seamlessly with the internal team of Destination Specialists and Support Teams to ensure an exceptional level of partner satisfaction.
Maintain a competitive edge by continuously monitoring industry trends, competitor strategies, and shifts in customer preferences to inform partner guidance.

Commercial & Results Focus
Entrepreneurial & Commercially Driven: Growth focused, never settle.
Execution & Urgency: Demonstrated ability to grow accounts with a focus on delivering results and swift execution , paired with a strong sense of urgency in a dynamic environment.
Negotiation: Highly skilled in securing favorable terms and maintaining relationships.
Account Growth: Passionate about achieving success and excellence.
Analytical & Technical Acumen
Analytical Mindset: Possesses a strong analytical mindset and advanced data analysis abilities.
Technical Background: Strong technical background to support data-driven decisions.
Industry Knowledge: Good understanding of the online travel landscape.
Relationship & Collaboration
Internal Networking: Highly skilled in leveraging professional connections, demonstrating resourcefulness and the ability to effectively use internal networks and available tools .
Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build rapport with both clients and internal teams.
Teamwork & Independence: Embraces new ideas and works well in teams while also having the ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Foundational Experience
Required Years: 5+ years in B2B Account Management or Sales.
Industry Experience (Plus): Online Travel Agency, operator, or travel experience is a significant plus.

Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
